crossRefs.note: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother…
but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod…
added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized;
for John was not yet thrown into prison.
Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their…

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

people.name: Herodias
people.line: Wife of Herod Antipas who had John beheaded.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

people.name: Philip
people.line: Herod Antipas' brother, first husband of Herodias

translations.web: For Herod had arrested John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
translations.bsb: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
translations.kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
translations.asv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.
